notes.title: Production UPDATE
notes.notes:
It's been a long time since I last posted! Sorry about that.

HL was suppose to be released this year but due to people deciding it's a good idea to just drop everything and leave, it's not possible. 

I tried to keep production going but at the moment it's completely stopped until I get a loyal production team behind me. 

I don't wanna throw a date out there randomly just to please everybody. I work on HL in my free time because I believe in my vision and I want to see it through.

I want to say thank you to everyone who has been patient and loyal. I ran into this with out a plan B.

Will speak soon!

-Thomas

P.S: I will be in the chat room if anyone wants to ask any questions!
